metadata.title: ShinyHunters: data-extortion at SaaS scale (and the Florida DMV claim)

notes: Financially-motivated data-theft-and-extortion crew (since 2020), part of the 'scattered LAPSUS$ hunters' overlap with Scattered Spider / The Com. No encryption - steal and extort. The Florida DMV listing (Sep 2026) is an ACTOR CLAIM on a leak site, not a confirmed or officially acknowledged breach; graded accordingly per project honesty rules. Live event as of this catalog date - details still emerging.

entities.name: ShinyHunters
entities.notes: Data-extortion group since 2020. Behind the 2024 Snowflake-customer mass wave (AT&T, Ticketmaster, etc.) and the 2025-26 Salesforce/OAuth supply-chain campaign. 2026: 30-40+ claimed victims incl. Canvas/Instructure, Carnival, Charter, Rockstar, Telus, the European Commission. TTPs: AI-assisted vishing (Vapi/Bland AI), Salesforce Experience Cloud misconfig, OAuth token abuse, and occasional zero-day (e.g. CVE-2021-35587 Oracle Access Manager). Leaks/sells via BreachForums-lineage and direct extortion.

entities.name: Florida_DMV
entities.notes: State of Florida DMV / FLHSMV. CLAIMED by ShinyHunters on a leak site (published 2026-09-07; 'FINAL WARNING', deadline 2026-09-11; no ransom figure stated). Data claimed: driver-license info, photos, signatures, addresses, vehicle records from Florida's DAVID system. UNVERIFIED and credibility-questioned: the published 'proof' was an EXPIRED record tied to Jeffrey Epstein that had already appeared in public DOJ documents - so it does not establish current DAVID access. FLHSMV issued no confirmation. No acquisition vector disclosed.

entities.name: Snowflake
entities.notes: Cloud data-warehouse whose customer tenants were mass-raided in 2024 via stolen credentials against accounts lacking MFA - the incident that scaled ShinyHunters into hundreds of millions of records. The platform was not breached; customer credential hygiene was.

entities.name: Salesforce
entities.notes: SaaS CRM at the center of the 2025-26 campaign: ShinyHunters abused OAuth-connected apps (Salesloft/Drift-style integrations) and Experience Cloud misconfigurations to pull customer data from many downstream tenants at once.

entities.name: Voice_Phishing
entities.notes: VECTOR (initial access): AI-assisted vishing (Vapi, Bland AI) impersonating IT/helpdesk to harvest SSO credentials and push MFA enrollment - the human-first foothold shared with Scattered Spider / The Com.

entities.name: OAuth_Token_Abuse
entities.notes: VECTOR (supply chain): stealing/abusing OAuth tokens from connected third-party SaaS apps to reach the primary tenant's data without a password or MFA prompt - one integration compromise fans out to hundreds of victims.

entities.name: Data_Extortion
entities.notes: The business model: exfiltrate and threaten publication for payment - no encryption. Lower operational cost than ransomware and sidesteps backup-based recovery entirely; leverage is reputational + regulatory, not availability.

entities.name: OAuth_Scope_Minimization
entities.notes: MITIGATION: inventory connected OAuth apps, minimize granted scopes, short-lived tokens, and revoke/rotate on anomaly - shrinks the blast radius of a compromised integration.

edges.notes: Unverified; 'proof' sample was a stale public Epstein record, FLHSMV silent, deadline 2026-09-11.
Conditional on the claim being real; identity data typically monetizes via resale.

edges.instrument: phishing-resistant MFA defeats vishing cred theft
still active (30-40+ claims in 2026) despite affiliate arrests
